notablePrerequisites: Tempting Licid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tempting Licid by tapping it and paying {G}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating four Saproling creature tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers four times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Saproling creature token, adding {G} each time.
Pay {G} to end Tempting Licid's effect, making it a creture once more.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
Sacrifice any number of Saproling creature tokens for infinite mana in any combination of colors.
